title: Juicy Greek Red Onions Spanakopita
description: A winey and savory Greek dish featuring red onions, spinach, and feta cheese, cooked to perfection in a wok and served in a stone bowl, perfect for a rainy day.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wok over medium heat.
Add the sliced red onions and cook until they are caramelized and golden brown.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped spinach and cook until it is wilted.
Stir in the crumbly feta cheese and cook for 1 minute, until combined.
Add the white wine and cook for 2 minutes, until the liquid is reduced.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Layer the filo dough in the wok, brushing each layer with olive oil.
Spoon the onion and spinach mixture into the center of the filo dough.
Fold the filo dough over the filling to form a triangle or square shape.
Cook the spanakopita over medium heat for 5 minutes, until the filo dough is golden brown and crispy.
